typography.primary_heading: Anton, Bebas Neue, or condensed equivalent (Enormous, expressive, uppercase only)
typography.secondary_heading: Cormorant Garamond or Playfair Display (Editorial serif for contrast)
typography.body: Manrope or Outfit (Modern clean sans for nav/info/general text)
typography.technical: JetBrains Mono or IBM Plex Mono (For micro-labels, numbers, and technical details)
typography.scale_rules: H1 up to text-[10vw] or clamp for massive cinematic scale. Fluid scaling is mandatory.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain/noise overlay on dark backgrounds to give an editorial, print-like feel.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #171717 or #888680/30 for structure and division. Thin lines like editorial grids.
visual_enhancers.cursors: Custom desktop cursor. Dot for default, 'VIEW' text or custom shape for gallery hovers.
visual_enhancers.overlays: Progressive dark gradients (from-black/80 to-transparent) on images for text legibility, never fully obscuring the image unless intentional for hover.

grids_and_layouts.general: Strong asymmetric editorial composition. Break away from standard symmetrical boxes.
grids_and_layouts.hero: 90-100svh cinematic layout. Dominant photography, giant typography overlapping the image, technical micro-labels tucked in corners.
grids_and_layouts.portfolio: Asymmetric editorial/masonry gallery. Unconventional aspect ratios. Not just a clean grid.
grids_and_layouts.styles_section: Typographic interface. Large rows (e.g., border-b) with 01/OLD SCHOOL, etc. Images appear on hover (following cursor or fixed side).
grids_and_layouts.mobile: Mobile-first, but must feel like a deliberate mobile editorial composition, not just stacked desktop. Respect 80vh max-height for images on mobile.

motion.reveals: Masked line-by-line reveal on load for hero typography. Staggered image reveals on scroll.
motion.parallax: Subtle parallax on hero background and large artist photo.
motion.interactions: Hover zoom on portfolio images, underline expansion on links, smooth dark overlay transitions.
motion.marquee: Continuous horizontal brand marquee using react-fast-marquee or framer-motion.
motion.a11y: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query for all animations.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has sufficient contrast or relies on dark scrims/overlays. Minimum 4.5:1 for standard text.
accessibility.keyboard: Lightbox and interactive sections must have full keyboard navigation (Escape, arrow keys).
accessibility.aria: Mobile menu requires correct ARIA attributes. Interactive elements need data-testid for testing.

media.treatment: High contrast, slightly desaturated or moody photography to match the dark art editorial theme.
media.lightbox: Premium fullscreen lightbox with scroll lock, custom prev/next, and Escape to close.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Not strictly necessary for this editorial aesthetic. Focus heavily on framer-motion for 2D typographic and layout transitions. If using WebGL, reserve for custom cursor or subtle fluid image distortion on hover, but raw DOM manipulation with Framer Motion is preferred for the 'print magazine' feel.

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Build a custom React landing page using Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, and Lenis.
instructions_to_main_agent.header: Minimalist navbar overlaying hero. Transparent initially, transitions to dark (#080808/80) with blur and thin bottom border (#171717) on scroll.
sections: 1. Hero: 90-100svh. Big overlapping Anton/Bebas text, orange (#FF5A1F) graphic detail, masked line reveal.
2. Marquee: Continuous brand text (STUDIO MAX — TATTOO — PIERCING — SINOP —).
3. Portfolio: Masonry layout, asymmetric, custom cursor over images.
4. Styles: Typographic list (01/OLD SCHOOL, etc.) revealing images on hover.
5. Artist: 55-65% width photo, huge name typography, editorial quote.
7. Reviews: Editorial type, NO generic shadow cards. 4.6/5.0 Google Reviews. Quotes as text.
8. CTA: Huge type, #080808 background, WhatsApp CTA.
9. Location: Compact footer/module, address, Google Maps button.
instructions_to_main_agent.restrictions: Avoid SaaS landing look, rounded cards, generic gradients, and generic decorative icons. Everything must feel like a high-end fashion/art magazine.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background.
Provide guidelines for .js files not for .tsx files.
